claim_boundary: Candidate findings and fixes are not authoritative until exact-head Linux, hosted Windows, installer and regression validation complete.

defects.finding: The finance dialog edited the owner's live FinanceProfile object before Save. Cancel, invalid Save, rename, move or Excel import could leave unsaved values active in memory and affect a later calculation.
defects.repair: The dialog now edits a deep staged copy. Rename, move and import reopen the staged copy. The owner profile changes only after an atomic successful Save.

defects.finding: Malformed, unreadable or unsupported finance-profile.json could raise during GUI construction and prevent the local center from starting.
defects.repair: Loading is bounded and typed. An unreadable profile is atomically moved to a unique corrupt backup before an empty, unconfirmed profile is used. If preservation fails, profile editing and saving are blocked fail-closed.

defects.finding: A weaker legacy load/save implementation remained in _finance_profile_groups.py while finance_profile.py overrode only part of it, creating an unsafe alternative import surface and maintenance ambiguity.
defects.repair: The duplicate persistence implementation and its unused imports were removed. One bounded load path and one validated atomic save path remain.

defects.finding: The main window and finance dialog used fixed 1440x900 and 1120x760 geometry with minimum sizes that could exceed a 1366x768 display or a scaled Windows work area.
defects.repair: All primary/detail windows use centered bounded geometry with minimum size capped to the actual screen.

defects.finding: Profile loading used unbounded read_text and could attempt to decode an arbitrarily large local file.
defects.repair: Profile input is capped at 4 MiB before JSON decoding and oversized files are preserved through the corrupt-profile recovery path.

defects.finding: The normal unconfigured template produced a generic technical FAILED result even when runtime, known-answer finance, persistence, schema review and write-disable checks passed.
defects.repair: Self-test now distinguishes CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED from a technical failure. Ready configuration still requires and returns PASS; malformed configuration still returns FAILED.

defects.finding: Live-state language implied fixed user/accountant confirmation of cost/tax values, while the latest executable specification requires values to be entered and changed by the user through UI fields.
defects.repair: Live state now explicitly requires runtime user input, local persistence, no hard-coded business values and calculation blocking when mandatory values are empty or invalid.

defects.finding: Scrollable finance-profile tabs exposed a scrollbar but did not handle mouse-wheel events over their child controls.
defects.repair: Mouse-wheel bindings are applied recursively to the active scroll tree for Windows, macOS and Linux event forms.

defects.finding: Legacy construction-only GOV/M5 workflows can fail on later product/audit heads because their ancestry and path-count assertions are intentionally bound to old one-time construction units.
defects.repair: Do not weaken or rewrite historical evidence. Classify their construction-only jobs as N/A outside their original exact scope, while running current source/runtime/manifest contracts in the new exact-head workflow.
